_comment: Single source of truth for all skills in the leafcutter ecosystem. Portability decisions made during the agent-skill audit (2026-05-14). Portable skills have a template_path in leafcutter/templates/skills/. Domain-specific skills have portable: false and domain: 'bybit-trader'. The 'dependencies' field captures skill-to-skill invocation relationships; left [] for the initial pass where dependency mapping is non-trivial.

skills.name: Debug
skills.description: Multi-angle debugging workflow. Spawns three parallel investigative agents (database, backend, frontend/docs) to diagnose an issue from different perspectives, synthesizes findings, creates a fix ticket via create-ticket agent, and builds it via build-feature.

skills.name: Doc Enforcer
skills.description: Use when a coder agent finishes editing Python or SQL files. Enforces module docstrings, function docstrings, DECISION HISTORY block structure, and tail-tag ticket-traceability format on new entries. Also detects and reads .pending/adr_handoff.json to inject ADR back-links automatically.

skills.name: Feedback Analysis
skills.description: Read-side analysis pipeline for the Central Feedback Collection System. Produces a prioritized report structure from accumulated feedback data across all categories.

skills.name: Feedback Review
skills.description: Triage unresolved feedback entries from feedback.jsonl. Presents each entry grouped by category and prompts the user to create a ticket, dismiss, or skip.

skills.name: Frontend Design
skills.description: Optional skill for frontend-coder. Provides design principles that counteract generic AI aesthetics — strong typographic hierarchy, intentional negative space, distinctive colour choices, and component-level personality. Installed by the /onboard wizard when the user opts in.

skills.name: Glossary Bootstrap
skills.description: Full-repo glossary bootstrap. Scans all .md/.py/.sql files for novel jargon candidates, dispatches the glossary-triage agent in parallel batches, applies decisions to docs/glossary.md and docs/glossary_blacklist.md, and commits the result.

skills.name: Knowledge Query
skills.description: Cross-surface knowledge graph query. Invokes scripts/knowledge_query.py to search nodes across all paths.json surfaces (agents, tickets, docs, skills, ADRs, hooks). Supports keyword filter, surface filter, JSON export, and edge list output.

skills.name: Prompt Audit
skills.description: Systematically audits agent templates and skill files against the Prompt-Quality Checklist. Detects compound bash commands, missing signoff protocol, tool allowlist mismatches, and other convention violations.

skills.name: SQL Query Past Queries
skills.description: Scans the project's past-queries folder and surfaces prior queries relevant to the current request. Returns a ranked list of candidate queries for reuse.

skills.name: Webapp Testing
skills.description: Optional skill for frontend-coder. Provides Playwright-based UI verification: screenshots, browser console-log capture, and click/type interactions. Installed by the /onboard wizard when the user opts in.

skills.name: Roadmap Steward
skills.description: Wraps roadmap_query.py --audit to produce audit_result JSON (all_items, starved_items, off_roadmap_tickets) for product owner review workflows.

skills.name: Route Knowledge
skills.description: Knowledge routing classifier. Use when a user says 'remember this', 'capture this', or 'we should write this down'. Covers the full surface taxonomy (memory subtypes, CLAUDE.md inline/TOC, per-folder README, agent frontmatter, ADR, architecture doc, Diataxis docs, glossary, settings.json, ticket bodies, skills_config.json). Returns { target_surface, path, rationale }. Also used by documentation-expert as a pre-flight gate before Diataxis routing.

skills.name: Finalize Feature Archive Check
skills.description: Pre-archive validation gate invoked by finalize-feature.js Step 5 before moving an epic folder to tickets/99_done/. Scans every sub-ticket in the epic's done/ subfolder and verifies frontmatter status: done. Offers confirmation-gated auto-fix for missing entries.

skills.name: Plan Feature
skills.description: Triage, orchestrate, and gate AC authoring for a user's feature request. Dispatches ac-triage (Haiku) to classify the request as strategic / behavioral / technical / covered, then routes through the correct authoring agents (PO v3, BA v3, IT PO v3) with user confirmation gates between stages. All output goes exclusively to the AC store — no ticket files are produced.

skills.name: AC Tree Split
skills.description: Guided procedure for splitting overcrowded AC trees. Loaded by PO v3 (for L0/L1 splits) and BA v3 (for L2 redistribution). Prompt-based — no enforcement scripts. Covers horizontal splits (same component, new sibling L0) and intermediate splits (L1 split into sibling L1s). Vertical splits (new sub-component) deferred to v2.

skills.name: Add Component
skills.description: Agent-facing wrapper around scripts/add_component.py. Provides a structured interface so agents can add a new entry to docs/components.json during a workflow without knowing the script path or argument format.

skills.name: AC Scanner
skills.description: AC store scanner and ticket generator. Wraps scan_ac_store.py (queries the AC YAML store for ready leaf-level ACs) and generate_ticket_from_ac.py (generates a fully-wired ticket file from a single AC YAML record and writes the implemented_by back-reference). Used by the /build-ac command to drive the AC-first build loop.

skills.name: Build AC
skills.description: Reference skill for the build-ac coordinator. Documents the three routing modes (leaf, goal, L1-no-children), the mode-detection algorithm, and the exact output contracts for each path. Load when implementing or auditing the build-ac agent template, writing tests for mode-detection logic, or diagnosing a mis-routing bug.

skills.name: Quick Fix
skills.description: Fast, in-place bug-fix pipeline. Operates in the current worktree without creating a new branch or worktree. Accepts a structured bug diagnosis and drives: AC creation, test-first (red), warning check, fix, green phase, commit, and close. Escalates to the full /build-feature pipeline when scope expands beyond the single target file.

skills.name: AC Audit
skills.description: Evidence-based implementation audit of an AC area (component, id-prefix, or store subpath). Answers per AC: is it really implemented, by which code, and by which green unit test? Treats work_status/implemented_by/covered_by as untrusted and verifies against the repo (grep citation maps, ticket files_touched, a live test run) plus skeptical per-group agents that catch phantom-done code. Produces a per-AC verdict report and, on request, evidence-anchored reconciliation and remediation/test-backfill work orders.
